data.content_ref: inline:SRC_010's structural closure family, SRC_005's support chains, and SRC_008's admissible enrichment abstracts to one mechanism: monotone, pure, polynomial graph transformations that add attack edges or nodes among non-committed-root material and leave the grounded fixpoint provenance-blind. The causal mechanism is that all three are pre-fixpoint syntactic expansions whose only load-bearing validity constraint is that no accepted attacker reaches a committed root. REFUTED IF the grounded extension distinguishes an edge or node by provenance (auxiliary vs primitive vs enrichment-generated), or if any of the three transformations generates an edge incident to a committed root, breaking the shared abstraction.
